Irene—

Thanks for the package. We reviewed the drafts with our in-house counsel and captured tracked changes (redlines_nexera.pdf attached). High-level items we can't accept as-is: 

1) Term / Auto-renew: We prefer a 12-month firm term with automatic 12-month renewals unless terminated (we are reticent to lock into 18 months without pricing protections).
2) Data retention: the MSA currently allows longer retention; need explicit 180-day max for customer PII and logs.
3) Indemnity / liability cap: propose the cap be bumped to 2x fees for gross negligence and maintain carveouts for IP claims.
4) Audit & security: your audit language is broad — we need narrower scope and scheduled notice.

We included margin comments in the PDF; see page 4 for the indemnity language and page 7 for data retention.

We are open to a commercial concession if Redwood will provide a sign-on credit and a defined ramp schedule for the extra capacity. Please confirm your position on term/credit/retention and send a consolidated redline back for execution.

Best,

Vanessa / Irene — quick legal note and proposed language below. I think the commercial compromise works but we should be explicit on a few points. 

Proposed retention clause (suggested insertion into Section 7.b):
"Customer Data: Redwood will retain Customer PII and operational logs for a maximum of 180 days following collection, except as required by law. Redwood will provide a documented retention schedule and delete APIs for exported datasets upon customer request."
